en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing an outdoor café terrace filled with well-dressed men and women in late 19th–early 20th century fashion, seated at tables beneath trees. In the background stands an ornate villa-like building with a steep tower roof, decorative half-timbering and balconies. Forested hills rise behind the structure. The lower margin and right edge contain printed German text, including the place name Karlsbad and the caption Café Kaiserpark, along with publisher information.
